finalText:
Build is green now. Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`, so `.toFixed()` was called on `undefined`. Changed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the boolean check only accepted literal `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Added an explicit `undefined → false` case.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the bumped packages (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, sync loader hooks, `punycode`, `module.parent`, plus a couple of app-level lint-style warnings) — none of those block the build or indicate broken behavior, so I left them as-is.
